fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
Of 36 scanned sheets, 4 go to a person to check

Ferro Valley Water District has 36 paper sign in sheets from last year's safety committee meetings. Each scan is read into the same fields as the phone form. On 4 sheets a name is read at low confidence, and safety coordinator Gideon Marsh checks those before they are saved.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { toolboxTalks: "I run a toolbox talk for my construction crew every Monday. Build a safety sign in sheet where I fill in the topic, the date, and my name as the trainer once, and each crew member signs in on a phone with a printed name and an e-signature.", missedSessions: "Our warehouse holds a quarterly forklift refresher meeting for 25 operators. Build a sign in sheet that checks who signed against the roster and emails anyone who missed it with the date of the makeup session. Mark them as missed until they sign in at the makeup.", fireDrills: "We run fire drills at a medical office building with 3 floors. Build a sign in sheet staff open on their phones at the assembly point, and show the fire warden a live count by floor of who has signed in and who is still missing.", paperSheets: "Our safety committee kept a year of paper sign in sheets. Read each scanned sheet into the same fields as our new phone sign in sheet: the meeting, the topic, and each member's name. Send any name you are unsure of to our safety coordinator to check before it is saved." };
